baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
baseline_models.mechanism: Security is tested against a fourfold recurrence construction: settled confidence is followed by return after departure, a returning turn, and an other-after-first occurrence. One completed escape therefore cannot establish immunity.

activation_trace.role: Settled confidence supplies the false state that the recurrence sequence overturns.
Return after departure makes the prior rescue reversible rather than final.
A returning occurrence gives the threat an iterative pulse.
Other-after-first explicitly numbers the exposure beyond the earlier voyage.

changed_reading.before: The verse warns of a second maritime danger after an earlier rescue.
changed_reading.after: The verse attacks the inference that a finished escape produces lasting safety: the same domain can receive them again in a renewed turn.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم
baseline_models.mechanism: The two fa-links form a material sequence: a released wind rapidly breaks the carrying structure, after which water engulfs its occupants. Drowning is the downstream result of destroyed carriage, not an unarticulated weather event.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch supply the initiating force in the causal chain.
Rapid breaking supplies the intermediate failure of vessel or structure.
Blowing air supplies the physical carrier of the breaking force.
Immersion to destruction supplies the terminal result of structural failure.

changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a staged collapse: force is released, the means of carriage is broken, and only then are its occupants engulfed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِۦ تَبِيعًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The causal covering of a benefit creates a consequence that follows the actors, while the final clause denies discovery of any rights-claimant able to press a counterclaim against God. The close pivots from their attached liability to the absence of liability enforceable against Him.

activation_trace.role: Covering a benefit makes concealed or unacknowledged favor the stated cause of the reversal.
Finding supplies the failed search for an effective avenue of recourse.
The rights-claimant supplies the legal pursuer who would have to press a case against God.
Attached liability supplies the consequence that follows an actor because of a deed.

changed_reading.before: They drown for disbelief and find no avenger.
changed_reading.after: Their covering of received benefit carries a following liability, yet no claimant can reverse the relation by establishing a liability against God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah assigns collapse and projectile wind to the land-side, then the focus ayah returns the audience to sea for ship-breaking wind. The repeated security question turns land and sea into alternating exposed surfaces, so changing location cannot convert rescue into immunity.

activation_trace.role: The repeated settled-confidence image links both warnings as one test of false security.
Ground sinking converts apparent terrestrial support into the first exposed medium.
Side or flank makes refuge-selection itself part of the challenged logic.
Dry land supplies the seemingly stable alternative to the sea.
A projectile-bearing wind makes the land-side threat structurally parallel to the focus wind.
Return after departure closes the attempted escape from one exposed medium to another.
The renewed turn makes alternation, rather than a single accident, the focus mechanism.

structural_cues: 17:68 and 17:69 repeat security question, dispatched threat, and no-finding closure while switching from land-side to return at sea.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired land and sea threats in a repeated frame; I infer that the switch of medium defeats refuge-by-relocation. A live alternative is that the two ayat simply enumerate independent dangers.

changed_reading.before: The focus warns that a later sea voyage can also be dangerous.
changed_reading.after: The return to sea completes a two-medium enclosure: neither reaching land nor re-entering water furnishes a safe side from divine reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle propulsion, mercy, rescue, and carrying establish a beneficent transport relation. Turning away and covering that benefit invert the same relation: dispatched wind no longer moves the vessel toward provision but breaks the means of carriage and lets the sea engulf its passengers.

activation_trace.role: Gentle driving supplies the beneficent mode by which the vessel initially moves.
Merciful tenderness identifies propulsion and provision as favor rather than neutral mechanics.
Release through separation supplies the completed rescue from sea distress.
Turning one's side away supplies the human reversal immediately after rescue.
Covering a benefit names the response that converts received rescue into unacknowledged favor.
Bearing an overt load confirms carriage on land and sea as an active gift.
Bestowed honor prevents the threat from being read as a denial of prior human dignity.
The focus causal phrase makes covered benefit the hinge of the transport reversal.
Rapid breaking turns the formerly carried vessel into the failed object of carriage.

structural_cues: 17:66-70 moves from gentle sea transport and rescue, through post-rescue turning away, to destructive return, then immediately reaffirms honored carriage on land and sea.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beneficent propulsion, rescue, turning away, covered benefit, destructive wind, and honored carriage; I infer a reversal of one transport relation. A live alternative reads kafartum as general rejection without foregrounding ingratitude.

changed_reading.after: The storm reverses a mercy already experienced: the agency that gently drove and carried now breaks the carrier after rescued passengers cover the gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, following is a chosen allegiance that leads into complete recompense; in the focus close, the same root names a rights-pursuer who cannot be found against God. The sequence separates followers who incur consequence from a nonexistent claimant able to pursue a counter-liability.

activation_trace.role: Following and conforming supplies the earlier voluntary relation to the tempter.
Matching deed with recompense makes following causally answerable.
Undiminished fullness closes any gap in the recompense attached to that following.
A rights-pursuer reverses the earlier root from one who follows into one who follows up a claim.
Following liability links the chosen allegiance to the consequence that adheres to it.

structural_cues: The pericope opens the consequence sequence with man tabi'aka in 17:63 and closes the focus warning with no tabi' in 17:69.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root, chosen following, full recompense, claimant, and attached liability; I infer a deliberate role reversal from liable follower to impossible counter-claimant. A live alternative treats the two root senses as independent.

changed_reading.before: No pursuer or avenger can be found after the drowning.
changed_reading.after: Those who choose whom to follow acquire a fully following consequence, but cannot reverse direction and pursue God with a compensating claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distributes recourse across distinct offices: sufficient keeper, managing guardian, helping ally, and alteration of an established way. Repeated no-finding clauses progressively remove prevention, representation, assistance, counterclaim, and eventual conversion of the governing order.

activation_trace.role: Doing what suffices locates effective guardianship positively with God.
One who manages an affair with preserving sufficiency supplies the affirmed guardian role.
The same managing guardian role is denied to those seeking protection from the threatened event.
Repeated failure to find turns the focus closure into a reusable recourse formula.
Aid that makes a party prevail supplies the denied helper role.
A running, followed way supplies the stable order within which the no-recourse formula operates.
Change from one state to another supplies the final denied means of escaping that order.
The focus failed search anchors the wider sequence in its own final construction.
The rights-claimant identifies the particular avenue of recourse denied in the focus.

structural_cues: 17:68, 17:69, 17:75, and 17:77 repeat la tajidu or la tajid closures while changing the unavailable role or remedy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated failed-finding syntax, guardian and helper roles, and an unalterable followed way; I infer an ordered exhaustion of recourse. A live alternative hears independent rhetorical closures without a role sequence.

changed_reading.before: The drowned lack an avenger in that episode.
changed_reading.after: The missing claimant is one station in a comprehensive closure: no protector prevents, no representative answers, no helper prevails, and no change diverts the governing way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus syntax directly denotes another entry into the sea, while the split ع د د mapping and nearby resurrection language open a more distant scale. It remains anchored in the focus return, returning turn, and other-after-first construction, with packet branches for counted recurrence and ultimate return. Downstream prose should present it only as a measured-return or reckoning echo, not as a replacement for the immediate maritime syntax.

activation_trace.role: Return as destination or final return lets the immediate re-entry resonate beyond one voyage.
The split-root image of recurrence at counted times gives the second exposure a measured rather than random undertone.
A returning occurrence keeps the exploratory temporal scale anchored to explicit repetition.
A delimited span supplies the deferred horizon named earlier in the pericope.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour make ultimate return a live contextual echo.
The same mapped image of recurrence at set times ties deceptive promise to an apparently deferred schedule.
The severe event of the Day supplies the later reckoning horizon.
The later or other realm sharpens the discourse echo without changing the focus adjective's grammar.

changed_reading.before: Another sea voyage unpredictably repeats the danger.
changed_reading.after: The repeated voyage can be heard, cautiously, as a counted lower-scale return that anticipates the pericope's larger horizon of return and reckoning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because وجد is syntactically the ordinary verb find, and its split ج د د branch must not replace that sense with a noun meaning shore. It remains worth carrying as a spatial undertone because the focus moves from total engulfment to failed discovery of a claimant, while the packet explicitly offers the shore branch. Downstream prose should qualify it as imagery only: engulfment leaves neither an effective claimant nor figuratively an edge from which a counterclaim could be mounted.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَيُغْرِقَكُم ... لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِۦ تَبِيعًا

activation_trace.role: Engulfing occupation of the whole field supplies the total spatial closure.
The split-root shore image supplies an exploratory edge or standing place within the failed-finding clause.
The rights-pursuer keeps the spatial image subordinate to the actual recourse relation.
Vast abundant water establishes the domain in which an edge would matter.
Dry land supplies the nearby contrast to engulfment and the lost possibility of a stable edge.

changed_reading.before: After engulfment, no rights-pursuer can be found against God.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that legal sense, total engulfment leaves figuratively no shore or boundary from which such a counterclaim could gain purchase.

strongest_changes: The paired 17:68-69 frame turns land and sea into alternating exposed media and defeats security by relocation.
The 17:66-70 sequence turns the storm into a reversal of merciful propulsion, rescue, and honored carriage after benefit is covered.
The repeated ت ب ع and no-finding constructions recast the final pursuer as part of a follower-liability and exhausted-recourse system.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah combines unusually dense recurrence wording, a material release-break-engulf chain, and a final legal-role reversal; split mappings add contained temporal and shoreline echoes without displacing the surface syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: ك ف ر can foreground covered blessing or general rejection; the immediate rescue sequence strengthens but does not force the ingratitude branch.
تَبِيعًا can emphasize claimant, pursuer, attached liability, or more general follower; the context sharpens their relation without eliminating the polysemy.
The counted-return, reckoning, and shoreline activations are branch-supported discourse echoes, not alternate grammatical parses.
